text: This page compares the new and old maps of zones as they appeared during WoW's original release in 2004. Zones that have substantively changed on the map are marked with a *.

This article consists of Forever mounts unique to its experience or that were backported from an expansion. In most cases, these mounts do not carry over to other flavors. However, some mounts may eventually find their way to another flavor (Summon Forsaken Charger) or are made available in Forever and another at the same time (Veteran Adventurer's Loyal Companion and Cerulean Prideclaw).
This article consists of Forever companions unique to its experience or that were backported from an expansion. These companions do not carry over to other flavors.

Forest Sprites are air elementals found at Shadowgale Forest on Zephras Isle. They have either 13,748 (at level 7), or 15,655 (at level 8) health. When attacked, they will emote "", and will then vanish. They will later reappear with full health.

The Forged Scarlet Memorandum is created by using the Scarlet Lieutenant Signet Ring with the Writing Supplies in the Brill Town Hall. It can be turned in to the nearby Jamie Nore for Rune of Mutilation.

Forged Legend's Pennant is an achievement reward from Legend: The War Within Season 1 or Strategist: The War Within Season 1.

Forgemaster Algrin is a djaradin located in Suffusion Camp: Frostburn in the Azure Span. A member of the Zaqali, he is subordinate to Igira, and is berated by her as the adventurers of the Alliance and Horde dismantle the Zaqali operation he leads. Algrin is eventually slain by adventurers as part of their efforts, and Igira swears their deaths to avenge her apprentice.

Forgemaster Kraglin is a djaradin located in Suffusion Camp: Cinderwind in the Ohn'ahran Plains.A member of the Zaqali, he is subordinate to Igira, and is berated by her as the adventurers of the Alliance and Horde dismantle the Zaqali operation he leads. Kraglin is eventually slain by adventurers as part of their efforts, and Igira swears their deaths to avenge her apprentice.
The Forge of Arcanum is located at the Cobalt Assembly in the Azure Span.

Forged Combatant's Heraldry was an optional crafting reagent used by Khaz Algar professions to craft The War Within Season 1 PvP gear. Aside from weapons, usually 3, 4, or 5 are required to craft a single piece of gear. They can be obtained in several different ways. # Looted from PvP strongboxes, such as Glorious Contender's Strongbox and Field Medic's Hazard Payout # Looted from War Supply Chests and bounties in War Mode # Bought from Hotharn at the Contender's Gate in Dornogal for # Can be bought and sold on the Auction House

Forged Aspirant's Heraldry was an optional crafting reagent used by Khaz Algar professions to craft The War Within Season 1 PvP gear. Aside from weapons, usually 3, 4, or 5 are required to craft a single piece of gear. They could be obtained from either Hotharn or Velerd at the Contender's Gate in Dornogal for .

Forged Gladiator's Heraldry was an optional crafting reagent used by Khaz Algar professions to craft The War Within Season 1 PvP gear. Aside from weapons, usually 3, 4, or 5 are required to craft a single piece of gear. They can be obtained either from Gathering All Gladiators! or could be bought from Hotharn and Lalandi at the Contender's Gate in Dornogal for .
Forged Framework is a finishing crafting reagent that increases Ingenuity while crafting items created with the Blacksmithing, Enchanting, and Leatherworking professions from the expansion .
Forger's Font Inspector is created with Khaz Algar Jewelcrafting (35); taught by Design: Forger's Font Inspector.

The Forge Core is the central room of Manaforge Omega. Portals lead to the Unbound Vault, the Cultivation Chambers, and the Technomancers' Terrace.
